question: What are the template ids of any templates used in more than a single document?
gold_query: SELECT template_id FROM Documents GROUP BY template_id HAVING count(*)  >  1

final_sql: SELECT T2.Template_ID FROM Documents AS T2 GROUP BY T2.Template_ID HAVING COUNT(T2.Template_ID) > 1
explain: The original SQL was almost correct. I've added an alias for the Documents table (T2) and used COUNT(T2.Template_ID) instead of COUNT(*) in the HAVING clause for slightly better explicitness, though COUNT(*) would also work functionally here. The query correctly identifies template IDs used in more than one document by grouping on Template_ID in the Documents table and filtering based on the count. A join to the Templates table is not necessary as all required information (Template_ID and its occurrences) is available within the Documents table itself.
